'''Kiregan Freem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and prominent member of the [[Exchange]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Year" /> he was killed by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual working for [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Vuk Dimitrius]].<ref name="TOR" />
